entities.name: Melek
entities.description: An icy, loosely humanoid elemental wizard of the Izzet League, created as the Izzet maze runner, killed by Ral Zarek and later resurrected as liaison to the Agency.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Izzet researcher of the Implicit Maze who sapped Melek's energy to become the runner; planeswalker.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: A race between the guilds, run by Izzet's chosen runner.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: Investigative agency to which Melek acts as Izzet liaison.

events.summary: Izzet mages create Melek to run the Implicit Maze, and Ral is assigned to coordinate instead.
events.quote: Melek was created by Izzet mages to run the Implicit Maze against the other guilds

events.summary: Ral Zarek saps Melek's elemental energy, killing him, and becomes the runner.
events.quote: Ral sapped Melek's elemental energy, thus killing Melek and becoming the runner.

events.summary: Melek is resurrected as the Izzet liaison to the Agency.
events.quote: Melek was resurrected to act as an ongoing liaison for the Izzet

relations.note: Sapped his energy to take his place as runner
relations.quote: Ral sapped Melek's elemental energy, thus killing Melek and becoming the runner.
Melek was created by Izzet mages

relations.note: A weird wizard of the Izzet League
relations.quote: Melek is a weird wizard of the Izzet League on Ravnica .
